description: Route performance budgets. Each entry defines the maximum allowed resource consumption for a specific API operation, keyed on METHOD /path (exact OpenAPI path template). Measurement values are filled by the orchestrator after profiling. The gate (check-route-budgets.mjs) validates that each declared budget entry is well-formed and that no measured value exceeds its declared ceiling.

GET /build/{projectId}/tickets.note: Primary ticket list — high traffic, must be cheap

GET /me/access.note: Permission resolution — called on every authenticated page load. Redis-cached but DB path must be cheap.

GET /notifications.note: Notification list — called frequently from shell; must be very fast

GET /contacts.note: Contact list — sales primary list view

GET /build/{projectId}/sprints.note: Sprint list — called on board load

GET /mail/accounts.note: Mail account list — called on every /mail page load; DB-only, no provider calls

GET /mail/messages.note: Mail message list — calls up to 2 providers (Gmail + Outlook) in parallel; provider latency dominates; first-page cache hit is <200ms

GET /mail/messages/{messageId}.note: Single message detail including HTML body — provider call required; 1 MB ceiling covers rich HTML emails with inline base64

GET /mail/threads/{threadId}.note: Thread hydration — returns all messages in thread; Gmail threads can be large; 2 MB ceiling

POST /mail/send.note: Send mail — single provider call; latency ceiling is generous to cover provider delivery queue

POST /mail/reply.note: Reply to thread — single provider call; same ceiling as send

POST /mail/messages/{messageId}/actions.note: Label/archive/trash/star action — single provider call + cache invalidation + metadata deferred write

GET /mail/messages/{messageId}/attachmen.note: Attachment download URL — returns a signed/temporary download URL, not the binary; small response

GET /dashboard/personal.note: Home/personal dashboard — aggregates myTasks (2 queries), timesheets (1), leaveBalance (3-4), upcomingEvents (1), unreadNotifications (0-4 cached). Budget is the cache-miss ceiling: selfMember(1) + getMyIssues(2) + timesheets(1) + leaveBalance(4) + upcomingEvents(1) + unreadCount(3) = 12.

GET /chat/channels.note: Chat channel list — listMemberChannels path: getMembershipId(1) + pageRows(1) + findMany-channels-with-members(1) + unreadRows(1) + lastMessageRows(1) + resolvePeopleIdentities(1) + entity-resolution(0-1) = 6-7.

GET /chat/unread.note: Chat global unread count — getUnreadTotal: resolveMembershipId(1) + count-query(1) = 2; ceiling 3 covers the Redis read.

GET /calendar/events.note: Calendar range aggregate — runs up to 5 parallel sources (native, build, HR leaves, HR holidays, tasks); each source 1-3 DB queries + moduleAvailabilityFor per source + getDisabledKeys(1). Ceiling covers all sources enabled with cache-miss access checks.

GET /notifications/unread-count.note: Notifications unread count — Redis-cached path is 0 DB calls; cache-miss path: resolveMembershipId(1) + fetchLastReadId calls resolveMembershipId again(1) + watermark-select(1) + count-query(1) = 4. Ceiling 5 adds one slack for future watermark refactor.
